ROOMMATE AGREEMENT

This Roommate Agreement is made as of July 1, 2026 between Morgan Hale and Riley Pruitt (the "Roommates"), who share the house at 220 Alder Court.

1. House Rules. Each Roommate will keep the kitchen and the living room clean. Quiet hours are from 11:00 pm to 7:00 am.

2. Guests. Overnight guests may stay for up to two nights in a week.

3. Food. Each Roommate buys that Roommate's own food. Shared supplies are bought in turn.

4. Parking. Morgan Hale parks in the garage. Riley Pruitt parks in the driveway.

Signed:

______________________
Morgan Hale

______________________
Riley Pruitt
